definitions.explanation: A large natural elevation of the earth's surface. Mountains have great cultural significance in Japan.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}に{登|のぼ}りたいです。
examples.english: I want to climb a mountain.

examples.japanese: {富士山|ふじさん}は{日本|にほん}で{一番|いちばん}{高|たか}い{山|やま}です。
examples.english: Mt. Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{景色|けしき}がきれいです。

notes: 山 is a fundamental noun in Japanese. Many mountain names use 〜山 (yama/san/zan) as a suffix: 富士山 (Fujisan), 高尾山 (Takaosan). Mountains are important in Japanese culture and Shinto religion. Related: 山登り (yamanobori, mountain climbing).
